articles.title: Major crypto exchanges increase transfer scrutiny with HTX over UK sanctions
articles.snippet: The UK sanctioned crypto exchange HTX due to alleged ties to Russian sanctions evasion networks and illicit financial activity.

articles.title: Crypto exchange HTX rejects U.K. sanction allegations, says it refused ruble stablecoin listing
articles.snippet: U.K. authorities sanctioned HTX, saying there were "reasonable grounds to suspect" the crypto exchange was helping Russia by cooperating with ruble stablecoin A7A5.

articles.title: HTX denies UK sanctions allegations as new data flags $7.6B Russia-linked flows
articles.snippet: UK sanctions Huobi Global S.A., operator of HTX, over alleged role in Russia’s “A7” shadow network, as new analysis claims the exchange handled billions in high‑risk flows.

articles.title: UK Issues Sanctions Against Justin Sun's HTX, Other Crypto Firms Over Alleged Russia Ties
articles.snippet: British financial institutions are now barred from doing business with the exchanges—and may face penalties for interacting with crypto transactions that pass through them.
